name: forkyard
description: Agent-native Git platform on Cloudflare: many agents, one codebase, forks compared side by side.

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-dist.mjs && bun run --cwd apps/worker db:migrate:local && bun run --cwd apps/worker build:types && concurrently -k -n emulate,worker,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "bun run emulate" "bun run --cwd apps/worker dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/worker db:migrate:remote && bun run --cwd apps/worker deploy
